2609.05920.title: Versioned Transitive Dependency-Closure Binding and Operation-Time Effect Governance for Agent Skills: ClosureBound
2609.05920.paper_summary: Agent Skills combine instructions with files, packages, tools, models, and services, so operational identity can exceed a signed directory. Recursive or lazy dependencies may change while root-level evidence remains valid, and different surfaces may reach the same durable effect. We present ClosureBound, a reference monitor that prevents authorization transfer across material changes to this heterogeneous closure. Its resolver commits typed graph nodes and topology. Each grant binds an exact closure root, effect ceiling, purpose/provenance, validity, and epochs. At durability, it re-resolves closure and state, normalizes the operation into an external-effect IR, and admits it only if a joint witness satisfies every bound. Supported equivalent paths share one ceiling. Assuming complete mediation and discovery, authenticated freshness, sound normalization, cryptographic binding, and authoritative linearization, we establish metadata non-authority, closure determinism, version non-inheritance, effect non-amplification, bound-value freshness, and path invariance. We do not establish program equivalence or remote-service honesty. A provider-free implementation matches 40 frozen lifecycle fixtures; 18 kernel contracts and six mutants cover binding and downgrade cases. Full-profile exploration reaches 84,608 states and 530,752 transitions without a declared invariant violation; six weakened profiles yield witnesses. A lexical audit of 549 public Skills (4,872 unique files) finds that 21 of 526 roots with bundled files name every non-manifest path verbatim, 67 contain links resolving outside their roots, and no root declares a frontmatter dependencies field. These observations motivate conservative closure discovery and define concrete targets for broader runtime, interoperability, efficacy, and production validation.
2609.05920.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能結合指令與檔案、套件、工具、模型和服務，因此操作身份可以超越簽署的目錄。遞迴或延遲依賴可能會改變，而根級證據仍然有效，並且不同的表面可能達到相同的持久效果。我們提出了 ClosureBound，一個參考監控器，防止在對這個異質閉包進行物質變更時轉移授權。它的解析器提交類型化的圖節點和拓撲。每個授權綁定一個確切的閉包根、效果上限、目的/來源、有效性和時期。在持久性方面，它重新解析閉包和狀態，將操作標準化為外部效果 IR，並僅在聯合見證滿足每個限制時才接受它。支持的等效路徑共享一個上限。在假設完全中介和發現、經過身份驗證的新鮮度、健全的標準化、加密綁定和權威線性化的情況下，我們建立了元數據非權威性、閉包確定性、版本非繼承性、效果非放大性、綁定值新鮮度和路徑不變性。我們不建立程序等價性或遠程服務的誠實性。一個無提供者的實現匹配 40 個凍結的生命週期固定裝置；18 個內核合約和六個變異體涵蓋綁定和降級案例。完整的配置檔探索達到 84,608 個狀態和 530,752 次轉換，沒有宣告的不變性違規；六個弱化的配置檔產生見證。對 549 個公共技能（4,872 個唯一檔案）的詞彙審計發現，在 526 個根中，有 21 個帶有捆綁檔案的根逐字命名每個非顯示路徑，67 個包含解析到其根以外的鏈接，且沒有根聲明前言依賴字段。這些觀察促使保守的閉包發現，並為更廣泛的運行時、互操作性、有效性和生產驗證定義具體目標。
2609.05920.author: Genliang Zhu et.al.
